div.div:
rewind adds (core unchanged)
• write_spk_ returns fOk + fopen guard (DI-07)
• fread_ / load_bin_ fStrict — errors on
truncated .jrc instead of misaligning (DI-04)
• dimm template from 1st non-empty chunk
— a quiet tail no longer zeroes dims (DI-03)
• onCleanup closes .jrc handles on throw (DI-13)
• fwrite_ short-write count check
